notes.huntcraft.gravadon.desc: A brute wyvern that swings its bedrock-hard skull crest like a war hammer. It carries moss-grown boulders on its back and sweeps foes aside with the rock club on its tail. It spits high-pressure water stored in its throat sac, and when enraged it shatters the ground to raise geysers. Slow, but every blow is devastating. Weak to thunder.
notes.huntcraft.azragos.desc: An elder dragon said to be cloaked in netherflame. The runes etched into its violet-black scales pulse with draconic power and blaze brighter as its fury grows. It sweeps the land with its breath, calls stars down from the sky, and when cornered unleashes a blast as if it had become a star itself. Until now it lived only in ancient legend.
